{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Gulf NRV power station''' is an operating power station of at least 256-megawatts (MW) in Nong Ra Viang, Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand.
It is also known as Nong Ra Viang power station, Nong Rawi power station.

==Background==

The combined cycle<ref name="Toyo">[https://www.toyo-eng.com/jp/en/company/news/?n=356 TOYO Group Awarded Natural Gas Fired Cogeneration Power Plant Projects in Thailand], TOYO Engineering Corporation website, Feb. 18, 2015</ref>, cogeneration project (combined heat and power, or CHP)<ref name="Gulf annual">[https://gulf.listedcompany.com/misc/ar/20190325-gulf-ar2018-en-05.pdf Gulf Annual Report 2018], Gulf website, March 25, 2019</ref> began selling electricity to the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) on May 1, 2019 under the Small Power Producer (SPP) program.<ref name="Gulf1">[https://www.gulf.co.th/en/news-media/news/gulf-nrv1-successfully-started-commercial-operation-to-egat-and-industrial-customers/ Gulf NRV1 successfully started commercial operation to EGAT and industrial customers], GULF website, May 1, 2019</ref>
